title: Git is each page's home; the database is the live view
ruling: Owner 2026-11-02 14:56 and 14:58 CST (fb-1456-1, fb-1458-2): "Git is each artifact's home. The claude.ai link is one account's view of it." Item 593 a (owner 12:40 CST Nov 12) fits on timing: the copy is exported in a timely enough way, not in real time. #2829's sentence "the page database is the one store, git a timely backup" contradicts the Nov 2 ruling, so #2829 is rewritten: git is home, the database is the live view one account writes through, the timely export stays, and the three cross-account fixes are added (retro and coordinator 12:08 CST Nov 13). Page item 730 closed as ruled; the owner was not asked again.
